description: Unique identifier generated for each final facility, in the format COUNTRYCODE-OPERATOR-NUMBER.
Name of the facility.
Operator of the facility: Amazon, Google or Microsoft.
Representative latitude of the facility, in decimal degrees (WGS84).
Representative longitude of the facility, in decimal degrees (WGS84).
Country where the facility is located.
Three-letter country code where the facility is located.
Broad region where the facility is located.
Sub-region where the facility is located.
Local timezone of the facility.
Difference from UTC in hours.
Identifier for a group of nearby facilities belonging to the same operator.
Number of records in the campus group.
Role of the record in capacity estimation, such as a facility or a site boundary.
Area of the site boundary, in m².
Area used as the building footprint to estimate capacity, in m².
Building height used to estimate the number of floors, in metres.
Source of the height or floor information, such as OpenStreetMap or Overture Maps.
Estimated total floor area in m²: footprint area multiplied by the number of floors.
Number of floors used to estimate total floor area.
Method used to determine the number of floors.
Confidence category for the estimated number of floors.
Method used to determine the building footprint area.
Confidence category for the building footprint estimate.
Estimated total facility power in MW, including IT equipment and supporting infrastructure.
Estimated power used by IT equipment, in MW.
Method used to estimate facility power.
Confidence category for the facility power estimate.
Assumed Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), the ratio of total facility power to IT power.
Operating status of the facility.
Type of source used for the record.
Identifiers of the source records.
Identifier of the original OpenStreetMap object, used together with osm_type.
OpenStreetMap object type: node, way or relation.
Additional information about the record, including exceptions or missing evidence.
